name: Qimen 'Zong' Black Tea - Traditional Leaf Wrap
marketing_tip: Individually wrapped in bamboo leaves for a unique, earthy infusion.
body: Experience the traditional 'Zong' style Qimen black tea. The tea leaves are bundled in bamboo leaves, which imparts a subtle, woody depth to the classic honey and fruit notes of Qimen tea. A wonderful gift for tea explorers.
